set.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes, checking that ship-change.toml's open-pr, push-merge and land go on.fail to a ship gate --failed triage whose on.pass is gate-fix (gate-fix-merge for land), that open-pr's and push-merge's triages have no on.fail and land-triage's on.fail is land-conflict-triage, that rebase still reaches gate-fix through rebase-triage and rebase-gate-failed, and that gate-fix's and gate-fix-merge's max_visits are unchanged; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipGate passes, showing ship gate --failed passing on a head the pre-push check failed on and failing after an open-pr or land failure that was not the pre-push check (a gh or push error); make self-check runs go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestRepoWorkflowsPrePushFix, which fails if a repo .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml lacks that routing (the ship gate --failed triages passing to gate-fix and gate-fix-merge), and any such copy on main carries it
set.statement: In the built-in ship-change workflow (and its wrappers such as bugfix), open-pr, push-merge and land, which have no on.fail today, each go on.fail to a triage step running rhiza ship gate --failed, as rebase does through rebase-triage and rebase-gate-failed; it passes only on a head the pre-push check (or local gate) failed on and then goes to the existing gate-fix fixer (gate-fix-merge after land) within its cap, and any other failure of those steps (gh, network, git) fails the triage and ends the run as today: open-pr's and push-merge's triages have no on.fail, and land's (land-triage) goes on.fail only to land-conflict-triage (ship-change-model-conflict-fix-step), which passes only for a recorded model conflict, so a gh, network or git failure of land still ends the run; ship gate --failed reports a head the pre-push check failed on, and the fixers' prompt reads the failing pre-push lines as well as a failing local gate's
